_meta.description: Curated per-category ongoing-earn rates for the highest-value / most-popular cards, keyed by the sibling credit-card-bonuses-api `cardId`. Maps finance-tracker's 10 internal spending categories (see app/services/enrichment/taxonomy.py) to an earn rate expressed as a PERCENT-EQUIVALENT, comparable to each card's flat `universalCashbackPercent`. A card that earns '4x points on dining' is recorded as `"dining": 4`. Any category a card omits here, and any card absent from this table, falls back to that card's flat `universalCashbackPercent` in card_recommendation.py — so this file is strictly additive and never regresses the flat model.
_meta.source: Public issuer reward schedules (agent-curated). Rates are the ongoing base multipliers for direct spend in each category; portal-only, rotating (e.g. Discover/Custom Cash 5%), and capped-spend nuances are intentionally not modeled in this first slice.
_meta.points_caveat: Points-denominated cards (Amex MR, Chase UR, Citi TY, Cap One miles) are recorded at their raw multiplier (e.g. 4x = 4). Transferable points are frequently worth more than 1.0 cent, so these values are CONSERVATIVE relative to a redemption-aware valuation. The engine's `points_value_cents` knob is applied to sign-up bonuses, not yet to ongoing earn.
_meta.provenance: Seeded per owner decision on issue #38 (path A). Pending owner verification of individual rates before treating as ground truth.
